% Pattern: theorem/newtheorem/revtex4-1. The class revtex prints the sections
% in capital Roman numerals, so a theorem numbered within the sections is II.1.
% seen in the gold pilot (set X)
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem I.1
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma II.1
% want lemma-2 statement/lemma II.2
\documentclass[aip,preprint]{revtex4-1}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem} Each tree is a graph. \end{theorem}
\section{Two}
\begin{lemma} Each path is a tree. \end{lemma}
\begin{lemma} Each star is a tree. \end{lemma}
\end{document}
